answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in oasis, verified in quill, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the atlas check. That bill is paid per identity, so 399 aliases cost 279 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
